test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Pragmatic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impractical**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pragmatic: **dealing with things sensibly and realistically in a way that is based on practical rather than theoretical considerations.
 
• **Impractical** is the correct antonym of pragmatic as it means not sensible or realistic; not practical. It is the opposite of pragmatic which is based on practical considerations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Meaning of the other options:
 
 
• **Prudent:** acting with or showing care and thought for the future.
 
• **Aesthetic: **concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.
 
• **Dull:** lacking interest or excitement.
